name: Seaplane
summary: Small propeller seaplane on two floats instead of wheels, in side view facing right; for lake, sea and coast scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the floats stands on y; it flies in the air above the water

params.name: s
params.note: scale: about 560 px wide and 360 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: fly = gentle hover and the propeller spins

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the seaplane faces left

author: krakujs
